contexts: regional pneumonia registry, 11,800 survivors discharged 2016 to 2021
linkage to death register and regional admissions pending
general population and infection comparison groups
reading: Frailty and existing heart disease sit before both the pneumonia admission and later events, so the size of any long-term effect depends on how they are measured and which comparison group is used. The first year after discharge carries most of the excess, and later years much less. Loss of independence is the outcome patients notice and registries rarely record. Everything rests on linkage that is not yet approved.
